messages:
Maria K: Ran a short sweep across A100/H100/L40S — saw weird latency jitter that correlates with allocator churn and KV cache eviction during seq/batch transitions. posting quick notes + logs.

Aj Patel: can you paste the exact command and config?

Maria K: sure — ran seq sweep (64,128,512,2048) x batch sweep (1,2,4,8) on model_xx_small_flashvariants, menv: h100-prod, kv_cache=on, prefetch=adaptive. command: `./bench_attn --model model_xx_small --seqs 64,128,512,2048 --bs 1,2,4,8 --devices a100,h100,l40s --kv on --prefetch adaptive`

Leon: saw similar before — allocator jitter usually when tensor arena crosses 2GB boundary and we trigger a separate CUDAMalloc path. might be bank conflicts + fallback to non-fused kernels.

Sophia: any flamegraph? where in the stack? kernel selection or memory manager?

Maria K: attaching small snippet from driver logs around spike (timestamps are relative ms).
```
[10234.12] H100 gpu0: launch fused_paged_attn variant=3 seq=512 bs=4 tokens=2048 latency=22.1ms
[10234.13] memmgr: free_pool trim -> cudaFreeLarge triggered (size=2.1GB)
[10234.13] fallback: kernel_selector chosen=matrixfold_fallback_gemm
[10234.14] H100 gpu0: new kernel start latency=48.7ms (cold path)
[10234.20] kvcache: eviction heartbeat collided with batch flush
```

Nate: kvcache eviction + cudaFreeLarge happening in same tick — that'll serialise streams and spike latency. two ideas: stagger eviction heartbeats and avoid trimming large pools mid-inference. also look at `--reserve-arena` flag.

Aj Patel: Can you reproduce with `--reserve-arena=256M`? if that keeps arena below the boundary we can rule out allocator as root cause.

Maria K: repro ran. with `--reserve-arena=256M` the 48ms spikes vanish but we still see small (~6-8ms) variance on H100 when switching from seq128->seq512 at bs>=4. that looks like kernel selector switching between fused_paged and paged_fallback.

Leon: if selector oscillates between two variants based on estimated workspace, you can get perf cliff at threshold. need hysteresis or prefer fused variant if it's within 5% speed. we pushed a selector tweak last month, maybe regression.

Sophia: can you bisect kernel-selector commits? also capture `KERNEL_DEBUG=1` trace — shows cost estimates and fallback reasons.

Maria K: kicked a bisect job on CI: https://ci.internal/infra/blue/organizations/jenkins/attn-bench/detail/alloc-jitter/23/artifacts — contains traces and perf.tar.gz. `ci-bot` will post when done.

ci-bot: CI job #23 finished. artifacts: /artifacts/alloc-jitter-23/perf.tar.gz, /artifacts/alloc-jitter-23/kernel-trace.log

Nate: quick look at kernel-trace.log — selector flip happened at commit d3f7b2 -> d3f7b9 where we changed workspace estimate for fused_paged. that commit reduced assumed workspace by 6% which moves some configs below threshold and forces paged_fallback.

Maria K: ok will revert locally and re-run the sweep. also trying a patched selector with hysteresis 8% margin.

Aj Patel: also check L40S behavior — its smaller memory bandwidth might prefer different tiling, so regression there could be independent. add `--tiling=auto,force_hybrid` runs.

Sophia: when you re-run, include `--profile pc` to get kernel timings + cupti counters (l2_misses, dram_bw). might reveal memory-bound vs compute-bound shifts.

Maria K: re-run results: revert -> fused_paged chosen more often, max-latency down from 52ms -> 24ms on H100 at seq512/bs4, overall p95 improved 3.2x. L40S still shows small unevenness at seq2048 where paged hits more often. attached summary in artifacts.

Leon: sounds like a selector regression. let's schedule a tiny revert PR for d3f7b9 and follow up with improved workspace estimator + hysteresis. thanks for hunting. :rocket: 

Nate: also leaving a note to change eviction heartbeat default to staggered in runtime conf (30s +- 3s jitter) so we don't get synchronized evictions across devices.

Maria K: filing two tasks: TICKET-1893 revert selector tweak; TICKET-1894 eviction jitter default. linking artifacts and notes. will post final perf run when PR merged.

Aj Patel: amazing work — concise repro and fix plan. ping me when PR is ready for QA. :thumbsup:
